# Folder names that belong to a Forge Neo UI Preset.
#
#   preset = folder, folder, ...
#
# Names are compared without regard to case, against the whole folder name.
# * stands for any run of characters, ? for one character.
# A preset's own name always matches and needs no entry: a folder "moss" or "MOSS" belongs to "moss".
# Only first-level folders (directly inside models/Lora, models/Stable-diffusion, ...) are matched.
#
# Do not edit this file: an update of the extension replaces it.
# Put your own lines in "aliases.txt" next to it. A line there replaces the line for the same preset here,
# and a line with nothing after the = removes it. Press Refresh on an Extra Networks page to apply.
#
# A preset stands for an architecture, and a model family's name can cover more than one.
# "krea" is the preset of Krea 2, an architecture of its own. The first Krea model (FLUX.1 Krea) is a Flux.1
# checkpoint and belongs to "flux". A folder named just "krea" is shown with the "krea" preset, so keep
# first-generation Krea files in a folder named "flux-krea", and name the Krea 2 folder "krea" or "krea-2".

anima   = anima-2.9b, anima-3.8b
fibo2   = fibo-2.0
flux    = flux-krea, chroma
h3image = minimax-h3, h3-image
ph3     = p-h3-image, p-h3
klein   = flux2, flux2-klein, klein-turbo
krea    = krea-2
qwen21  = qwen-2.1, qwen-image-2.1
wan     = wan*
zit     = z-image-base, z-image-turbo
